more_articles.extract: During 2026, parts of the United Kingdom were severely affected by a series of record-breaking heatwaves, forming the western extent of a broader sequence of extreme heat events across Western and Central Europe. article.extract: BepiColombo (Japanese: ベピ・コロンボ, romanized: Bepi Koronbo) is a joint mission of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) which, in 2026, became the second mission ever to enter orbit around the planet Mercury, the first being MESSENGER. It comprises two orbiters: the Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO), built and operated by ESA, and Mio (Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter, MMO), built and operated by JAXA. Together the spacecraft will perform a comprehensive study of Mercury, including characterization of its magnetic field, magnetosphere, and both interior and surface structure.

article.extract: Significant political, constitutional, and social changes in Bangladesh followed the July Uprising of 2024 and the resignation of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The uprising was initially sparked by widespread public protests and calls for reform, led to major changes in Bangladesh's political landscape.

headlines.html: In Gopalganj District, armed members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League detonate crude bombs and set fire to a private clinic owned by BNP Member of Parliament K M Babar of Gopalganj-2, forcing patients to evacuate. Attackers also burn at least five BNP offices across Muksudpur and Kashiani and target two Grameen Bank branches.

A crowd led by Chatra Dal members storms and sets fire to the residence of former Awami League Member of Parliament Shamim Osman in Narayanganj District, while unidentified attackers loot and set fire to two houses belonging to former Minister of Fisheries and Livestock SM Rezaul Karim in Pirojpur District. Separately, arsonists burn the residence of former Minister of Foreign Affairs Dipu Moni in Chandpur, and a crowd in Sirajganj vandalises the local Awami League office and the residence of former MP Habibe Millat.
Two Bangladesh Nationalist Party members are killed when suspected members of the banned Awami League attack a motorcycle procession in Narail District, Bangladesh.

article.extract: The 2026 Iran war fuel crisis is a worldwide fuel crisis caused by the war between Iran and the U.S.-Israel coalition. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which over 20% of the world's oil trade passes, and attacks on energy infrastructure in Iran and several Gulf Cooperation Council countries led to a large disruption in global oil supplies.

article.extract: The 2026 Italian unrest is an ongoing series of protests, demonstrations, strikes, and clashes in Italy that began on 18 September 2026. The unrest has involved student movements, labor unions and other protesters expressing discontent over the rising costs of living and fuel prices, education policies and public fiscal spending of the Meloni government.

article.extract: Cross-strait relations (sometimes called Mainland–Taiwan relations, China–Taiwan relations, or PRC–ROC relations) are the political and economic relations between China (officially the People's Republic of China, or PRC) and Taiwan (officially the Republic of China, or ROC) across the Taiwan Strait. Due to the existing controversy over the status of Taiwan and the Chinese legitimacy question, they are also not defined as diplomatic relations by either side.
article.title: Cross-strait relations
